title: Entrance to Hades

canonical.text:
You are outside a large gateway, on which is inscribed||
  Abandon every hope
all ye who enter here!||
The gate is open; through it you can see a desolation, with a pile of
mangled bodies in one corner. Thousands of voices, lamenting some
hideous fate, can be heard.

The way through the gate is barred by evil spirits, who jeer at your
attempts to pass.

prompt:
Create one complete static illustration of Entrance to Hades.

Viewpoint: Eye-level view from outside the great open gateway.

The scene establishes these features: You are outside a large gateway, on which is inscribed Abandon every hope all ye who enter here! The gate is open; through it you can see a desolation, with a pile of mangled bodies in one corner. Thousands of voices, lamenting some hideous fate, can be heard. The way through the gate is barred by evil spirits, who jeer at your attempts to pass.

Composition: Frame the threshold, desolation beyond and source-established remains in one corner; preserve the physical inscription carrier but show no legible text.

Appearance of this illustration: Show evil spirits barring the open gateway; the stone gate itself remains open.

Canonical room dressing: number of ghosts. Preserve this coarse room presentation unless the state description above specifies a different appearance.

Lighting and color: Somber gray-brown stone with restrained pale spectral tones only when the state calls for spirits.

Shared world design: Broad worn stone planes, ivory marble where explicit, dark brown timber; restrained ceremonial scale without adding religious symbols.

Style: Painterly adventure-game illustration recalling fine late-1980s and early-1990s computer artwork; natural proportions, restrained brushwork, readable silhouettes and broad tonal masses. Aim for roughly 256 visually significant colors, broad related color regions, controlled shading and clear dark/light separation. No exact RGB-count requirement, photographic color noise, excessive gradients or microtextures.

Keep this room camera, underlying architecture, terrain layout, light direction and palette consistent across its variants. Depict the complete scene, including the appearance stated above.

Landscape source composition near 4:3. Final scene is 256 by 159 pixels. Allow safe center cropping to 256:159, keeping essential subjects inside the central 82.8 percent of source height and away from the side boundaries. Use clear silhouettes and broad readable shapes at that final size.

Exclude game UI, borders, captions, labels, readable lettering, photographic detail, pixel grids and enlarged pixels. Do not add characters, significant props, openings or events beyond the established scene. Do not depict an action in progress or a before/after collage.
negative_prompt: No UI, borders, readable text, photorealism, pixel grid, invented props, extra exits or transient action events.
